verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for a consumer and business SaaS product like 1Password, but the evidence pack never documents an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The MCP servers, llms.txt files and CLI/SDK surfaces let external agents connect to 1Password, which is adjacent to this story rather than an assistant built into the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
